content_blocks.text: The old house stood silent and still, its windows like dark eyes staring out into the night. The air was thick with the scent of damp earth and forgotten memories. As the first light of dawn crept over the horizon, the door creaked open, revealing a figure cloaked in shadows. The footsteps were soft, almost ghostly, as if the very ground beneath them whispered secrets of the past.
